analysis.summary: Android Termux terminal displaying a Bash script that creates an executable payment-related script under the user's home directory. The script uses termux-dialog to request confirmation before executing a payment and shows a confirmation dialog with an error indicating that approval was not recognized.
analysis.visual_type: Android Termux terminal with Bash script and termux-dialog confirmation overlay
technical_clues: Bash shebang referencing the Termux Bash binary
A script named payment-api-execute.sh is written under $HOME/.daemeonai/
The script uses a 60-second timeout around termux-dialog confirm
The confirmation dialog title is 'DaemeonAI – Maksun vahvistus'
The dialog asks whether the user definitely wants to execute the payment
The script appears to branch based on a returned confirmation code
Cancellation triggers a terminal message and termux-toast notification
The script is made executable with chmod +x
The visible dialog reports 'Virhe: hyväksyntää ei tunnistettu' (approval not recognized)
analysis.possible_software_task: Implement or debug a Termux-based Bash payment execution workflow that requires explicit Android dialog confirmation, correctly interprets the termux-dialog result, handles timeout or cancellation, and notifies the user.
